name: chrome-extensions
description: Build and verify Manifest V3 extensions with Modern Web Guidance, optional Chrome DevTools testing, and truthful Web Store preparation.

interface.shortDescription: Build, test, and prepare Chrome extensions for the store.
interface.longDescription: Original workflows for Manifest V3 architecture, least-privilege permissions, modern web compatibility, accessible UI, built-in AI availability and fallback, optional Chrome DevTools MCP verification, and maintained CHROMEWEBSTORE.md metadata. Includes an offline manifest audit; no browser profile changes or MCP registration on install.
defaultPrompt: Use $chrome-extensions to build and test a Manifest V3 quick-notes popup with local storage.
Use $chrome-extensions to prepare this extension and CHROMEWEBSTORE.md for store review.
Use $modern-web-guidance to add feature-detected built-in AI with a usable fallback.
